name: Halloween Countdown Widget
author: Monica Haught

sections.description:
Get into the Halloween spirit with the Halloween Countdown Widget! This fun and festive widget lets you display a cute countdown to the spookiest night of the year. Choose from five adorable designs: the classic ‘Vampy’ Countdown, or one of our four new backgrounds—the Moon, a Ghost, a Cauldron, and Candy.

Easily add the countdown to your sidebar, footer, or any widget-ready area of your site. Whether your site is a full-fledged Halloween site or perhaps you just love a bit of seasonal fun, this widget is the perfect way to build excitement as Halloween approaches!

Features

  • Five Designs to choose from!
  • Transparent Backgrounds
  • Place in any widget ready area on your site!

More information at ChristmasWebmaster.com.
sections.installation:
1. Upload hallocount.php to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to your widgets screen, pick a place, then select your Halloween Countdown widget style.
  4. Let the countdown to Halloween begin!
sections.faq:
Does the bat have a name?

Of course he does! We call him Vampy.

Can I change the Countdown text color?

Yes. You can edit the halloween-countdown.css file to suit your needs.

Halloween widget appears broken after upgrading to V3.

In version 3 of the plugin, I added new backgrounds and updated the file structure within the plugin. After updating from a previous version, you will need to visit your widget area and select the countdown image you would like displayed.
